# slack-web-api: all Slack Web API methods

> Every Slack Web API method supported by the Rust crate `slack-web-api`, with the Rust function and types.
> Call pattern: `client.<function>(&<Request>::new(<required args>).<optional_arg>(value)).await?` returns `<Response>`.
> Required arguments are the parameters of `new`; every other argument is a builder method of the same name.


## admin.analytics

- `admin.analytics.getFile` -> `client.admin_analytics_get_file(&AdminAnalyticsGetFileRequest::new(r#type))` -> `bytes::Bytes`: Retrieve analytics data for a given date, presented as a compressed JSON file
- `admin.analytics.messages.activity` -> `client.admin_analytics_messages_activity(&AdminAnalyticsMessagesActivityRequest::new(channel))` -> `AdminAnalyticsMessagesActivityResponse`: Retrieves activity metrics for messages from a given channel.
- `admin.analytics.messages.metadata` -> `client.admin_analytics_messages_metadata(&AdminAnalyticsMessagesMetadataRequest::new(channel))` -> `AdminAnalyticsMessagesMetadataResponse`: Retrieves metadata for a list of messages from a given channel.

## admin.apps

- `admin.apps.activities.list` -> `client.admin_apps_activities_list(&AdminAppsActivitiesListRequest::new())` -> `AdminAppsActivitiesListResponse`: Get logs for a specified team/org
- `admin.apps.approve` -> `client.admin_apps_approve(&AdminAppsApproveRequest::new())` -> `AdminAppsApproveResponse`: Approve an app for installation on a workspace.
- `admin.apps.approved.list` -> `client.admin_apps_approved_list(&AdminAppsApprovedListRequest::new())` -> `AdminAppsApprovedListResponse`: List approved apps for an org or workspace.
- `admin.apps.clearResolution` -> `client.admin_apps_clear_resolution(&AdminAppsClearResolutionRequest::new(app_id))` -> `AdminAppsClearResolutionResponse`: Clear an app resolution
- `admin.apps.config.lookup` -> `client.admin_apps_config_lookup(&AdminAppsConfigLookupRequest::new())` -> `AdminAppsConfigLookupResponse`: Look up the app config for connectors by their IDs
- `admin.apps.config.set` -> `client.admin_apps_config_set(&AdminAppsConfigSetRequest::new(app_id))` -> `AdminAppsConfigSetResponse`: Set the app config for a connector
- `admin.apps.mcp.servers.list` -> `client.admin_apps_mcp_servers_list(&AdminAppsMcpServersListRequest::new())` -> `AdminAppsMcpServersListResponse`: List third-party app MCP servers approved for an organization.
- `admin.apps.mcp.servers.permissions.list` -> `client.admin_apps_mcp_servers_permissions_list(&AdminAppsMcpServersPermissionsListRequest::new(app_id))` -> `AdminAppsMcpServersPermissionsListResponse`: List MCP servers for an app with their access control permissions.
- `admin.apps.mcp.servers.permissions.set` -> `client.admin_apps_mcp_servers_permissions_set(&AdminAppsMcpServersPermissionsSetRequest::new(app_id, server_id, permission_type))` -> `AdminAppsMcpServersPermissionsSetResponse`: Set the access control permission for who can use an MCP server.
- `admin.apps.permissions.add` -> `client.admin_apps_permissions_add(&AdminAppsPermissionsAddRequest::new(app_id))` -> `AdminAppsPermissionsAddResponse`: Grant permission for entities to access an app that has its permission type set to named_entities.
- `admin.apps.permissions.list` -> `client.admin_apps_permissions_list(&AdminAppsPermissionsListRequest::new(app_id))` -> `AdminAppsPermissionsListResponse`: Returns the permission type of an app and the entities that have been granted access.
- `admin.apps.permissions.remove` -> `client.admin_apps_permissions_remove(&AdminAppsPermissionsRemoveRequest::new(app_id))` -> `AdminAppsPermissionsRemoveResponse`: Revoke an entity's access to an app that has its permission type set to named_entities.
- `admin.apps.permissions.set` -> `client.admin_apps_permissions_set(&AdminAppsPermissionsSetRequest::new(app_id, permission_type))` -> `AdminAppsPermissionsSetResponse`: Set the permission type for who can access an app.
- `admin.apps.requests.cancel` -> `client.admin_apps_requests_cancel(&AdminAppsRequestsCancelRequest::new(request_id))` -> `AdminAppsRequestsCancelResponse`: Cancel app request for team
- `admin.apps.requests.list` -> `client.admin_apps_requests_list(&AdminAppsRequestsListRequest::new())` -> `AdminAppsRequestsListResponse`: List app requests for a team/workspace.
- `admin.apps.restrict` -> `client.admin_apps_restrict(&AdminAppsRestrictRequest::new())` -> `AdminAppsRestrictResponse`: Restrict an app for installation on a workspace.
- `admin.apps.restricted.list` -> `client.admin_apps_restricted_list(&AdminAppsRestrictedListRequest::new())` -> `AdminAppsRestrictedListResponse`: List restricted apps for an org or workspace.
- `admin.apps.uninstall` -> `client.admin_apps_uninstall(&AdminAppsUninstallRequest::new(app_id))` -> `AdminAppsUninstallResponse`: Uninstall an app from one or many workspaces, or an entire enterprise organization.

## admin.audit

- `admin.audit.anomaly.allow.getItem` -> `client.admin_audit_anomaly_allow_get_item(&AdminAuditAnomalyAllowGetItemRequest::new())` -> `AdminAuditAnomalyAllowGetItemResponse`: API to allow Enterprise org admins to read the allow list of IP blocks and ASNs from the enterprise configuration.
- `admin.audit.anomaly.allow.updateItem` -> `client.admin_audit_anomaly_allow_update_item(&AdminAuditAnomalyAllowUpdateItemRequest::new())` -> `AdminAuditAnomalyAllowUpdateItemResponse`: API to allow Enterprise org admins to write/overwrite the allow list of IP blocks and ASNs from the enterprise configuration.

## admin.auth

- `admin.auth.policy.assignEntities` -> `client.admin_auth_policy_assign_entities(&AdminAuthPolicyAssignEntitiesRequest::new(policy_name, entity_type, entity_ids))` -> `AdminAuthPolicyAssignEntitiesResponse`: Assign entities to a particular authentication policy.
- `admin.auth.policy.getEntities` -> `client.admin_auth_policy_get_entities(&AdminAuthPolicyGetEntitiesRequest::new(policy_name))` -> `AdminAuthPolicyGetEntitiesResponse`: Fetch all the entities assigned to a particular authentication policy by name.
- `admin.auth.policy.removeEntities` -> `client.admin_auth_policy_remove_entities(&AdminAuthPolicyRemoveEntitiesRequest::new(policy_name, entity_type, entity_ids))` -> `AdminAuthPolicyRemoveEntitiesResponse`: Remove specified entities from a specified authentication policy.

## admin.barriers

- `admin.barriers.create` -> `client.admin_barriers_create(&AdminBarriersCreateRequest::new(primary_usergroup_id, barriered_from_usergroup_ids, restricted_subjects))` -> `AdminBarriersCreateResponse`: Create an Information Barrier
- `admin.barriers.delete` -> `client.admin_barriers_delete(&AdminBarriersDeleteRequest::new(barrier_id))` -> `AdminBarriersDeleteResponse`: Delete an existing Information Barrier
- `admin.barriers.list` -> `client.admin_barriers_list(&AdminBarriersListRequest::new())` -> `AdminBarriersListResponse`: Get all Information Barriers for your organization
- `admin.barriers.update` -> `client.admin_barriers_update(&AdminBarriersUpdateRequest::new(barrier_id, primary_usergroup_id, barriered_from_usergroup_ids, restricted_subjects))` -> `AdminBarriersUpdateResponse`: Update an existing Information Barrier

## admin.conversations

- `admin.conversations.archive` -> `client.admin_conversations_archive(&AdminConversationsArchiveRequest::new(channel_id))` -> `AdminConversationsArchiveResponse`: Archive a public or private channel.
- `admin.conversations.bulkArchive` -> `client.admin_conversations_bulk_archive(&AdminConversationsBulkArchiveRequest::new(channel_ids))` -> `AdminConversationsBulkArchiveResponse`: Archive public or private channels in bulk.
- `admin.conversations.bulkDelete` -> `client.admin_conversations_bulk_delete(&AdminConversationsBulkDeleteRequest::new(channel_ids))` -> `AdminConversationsBulkDeleteResponse`: Delete public or private channels in bulk
- `admin.conversations.bulkMove` -> `client.admin_conversations_bulk_move(&AdminConversationsBulkMoveRequest::new(target_team_id, channel_ids))` -> `AdminConversationsBulkMoveResponse`: Move public or private channels in bulk.
- `admin.conversations.bulkSetExcludeFromSlackAi` -> `client.admin_conversations_bulk_set_exclude_from_slack_ai(&AdminConversationsBulkSetExcludeFromSlackAiRequest::new(channel_ids, exclude))` -> `AdminConversationsBulkSetExcludeFromSlackAiResponse`: Exclude channels from Slack AI in bulk
- `admin.conversations.bulkSetProperties` -> `client.admin_conversations_bulk_set_properties(&AdminConversationsBulkSetPropertiesRequest::new(channel_ids, property))` -> `AdminConversationsBulkSetPropertiesResponse`: Set properties on channels in bulk
- `admin.conversations.convertToPrivate` -> `client.admin_conversations_convert_to_private(&AdminConversationsConvertToPrivateRequest::new(channel_id))` -> `AdminConversationsConvertToPrivateResponse`: Convert a public channel to a private channel.
- `admin.conversations.convertToPublic` -> `client.admin_conversations_convert_to_public(&AdminConversationsConvertToPublicRequest::new(channel_id))` -> `AdminConversationsConvertToPublicResponse`: Convert a private channel to a public channel.
- `admin.conversations.create` -> `client.admin_conversations_create(&AdminConversationsCreateRequest::new(name, is_private))` -> `AdminConversationsCreateResponse`: Create a public or private channel-based conversation.
- `admin.conversations.createForObjects` -> `client.admin_conversations_create_for_objects(&AdminConversationsCreateForObjectsRequest::new(object_id, salesforce_org_id))` -> `AdminConversationsCreateForObjectsResponse`: Create a Salesforce channel for the corresponding object provided.
- `admin.conversations.delete` -> `client.admin_conversations_delete(&AdminConversationsDeleteRequest::new(channel_id))` -> `AdminConversationsDeleteResponse`: Delete a public or private channel.
- `admin.conversations.disconnectShared` -> `client.admin_conversations_disconnect_shared(&AdminConversationsDisconnectSharedRequest::new(channel_id))` -> `AdminConversationsDisconnectSharedResponse`: Disconnect a connected channel from one or more workspaces.
- `admin.conversations.ekm.listOriginalConnectedChannelInfo` -> `client.admin_conversations_ekm_list_original_connected_channel_info(&AdminConversationsEkmListOriginalConnectedChannelInfoRequest::new())` -> `AdminConversationsEkmListOriginalConnectedChannelInfoResponse`: List all disconnected channels—i.e., channels that were once connected to other workspaces and then disconnected—and the corresponding original channel IDs for key revocation with EKM.
- `admin.conversations.getConversationPrefs` -> `client.admin_conversations_get_conversation_prefs(&AdminConversationsGetConversationPrefsRequest::new(channel_id))` -> `AdminConversationsGetConversationPrefsResponse`: Get conversation preferences for a public or private channel.
- `admin.conversations.getCustomRetention` -> `client.admin_conversations_get_custom_retention(&AdminConversationsGetCustomRetentionRequest::new(channel_id))` -> `AdminConversationsGetCustomRetentionResponse`: This API endpoint can be used by any admin to get a conversation's retention policy.
- `admin.conversations.getTeams` -> `client.admin_conversations_get_teams(&AdminConversationsGetTeamsRequest::new(channel_id))` -> `AdminConversationsGetTeamsResponse`: Get all the workspaces a given public or private channel is connected to within this Enterprise org.
- `admin.conversations.invite` -> `client.admin_conversations_invite(&AdminConversationsInviteRequest::new(user_ids, channel_id))` -> `AdminConversationsInviteResponse`: Invite a user to a public or private channel.
- `admin.conversations.linkObjects` -> `client.admin_conversations_link_objects(&AdminConversationsLinkObjectsRequest::new(channel, record_id, salesforce_org_id))` -> `AdminConversationsLinkObjectsResponse`: Link a Salesforce record to a channel
- `admin.conversations.lookup` -> `client.admin_conversations_lookup(&AdminConversationsLookupRequest::new(team_ids, last_message_activity_before))` -> `AdminConversationsLookupResponse`: Returns channels on the given team using the filters.
- `admin.conversations.removeCustomRetention` -> `client.admin_conversations_remove_custom_retention(&AdminConversationsRemoveCustomRetentionRequest::new(channel_id))` -> `AdminConversationsRemoveCustomRetentionResponse`: This API endpoint can be used by any admin to remove a conversation's retention policy.
- `admin.conversations.rename` -> `client.admin_conversations_rename(&AdminConversationsRenameRequest::new(channel_id, name))` -> `AdminConversationsRenameResponse`: Rename a public or private channel.
- `admin.conversations.restrictAccess.addGroup` -> `client.admin_conversations_restrict_access_add_group(&AdminConversationsRestrictAccessAddGroupRequest::new(group_id, channel_id))` -> `AdminConversationsRestrictAccessAddGroupResponse`: Add an allowlist of IDP groups for accessing a channel
- `admin.conversations.restrictAccess.listGroups` -> `client.admin_conversations_restrict_access_list_groups(&AdminConversationsRestrictAccessListGroupsRequest::new(channel_id))` -> `AdminConversationsRestrictAccessListGroupsResponse`: List all IDP Groups linked to a channel
- `admin.conversations.restrictAccess.removeGroup` -> `client.admin_conversations_restrict_access_remove_group(&AdminConversationsRestrictAccessRemoveGroupRequest::new(team_id, group_id, channel_id))` -> `AdminConversationsRestrictAccessRemoveGroupResponse`: Remove a linked IDP group linked from a private channel
- `admin.conversations.search` -> `client.admin_conversations_search(&AdminConversationsSearchRequest::new())` -> `AdminConversationsSearchResponse`: Search for public or private channels in an Enterprise organization.
- `admin.conversations.setConversationPrefs` -> `client.admin_conversations_set_conversation_prefs(&AdminConversationsSetConversationPrefsRequest::new(channel_id, prefs))` -> `AdminConversationsSetConversationPrefsResponse`: Set the posting permissions for a public or private channel.
- `admin.conversations.setCustomRetention` -> `client.admin_conversations_set_custom_retention(&AdminConversationsSetCustomRetentionRequest::new(channel_id, duration_days))` -> `AdminConversationsSetCustomRetentionResponse`: This API endpoint can be used by any admin to set a conversation's retention policy.
- `admin.conversations.setTeams` -> `client.admin_conversations_set_teams(&AdminConversationsSetTeamsRequest::new(channel_id))` -> `AdminConversationsSetTeamsResponse`: Set the workspaces in an Enterprise org that connect to a public or private channel.
- `admin.conversations.unarchive` -> `client.admin_conversations_unarchive(&AdminConversationsUnarchiveRequest::new(channel_id))` -> `AdminConversationsUnarchiveResponse`: Unarchive a public or private channel.
- `admin.conversations.unlinkObjects` -> `client.admin_conversations_unlink_objects(&AdminConversationsUnlinkObjectsRequest::new(channel, new_name))` -> `AdminConversationsUnlinkObjectsResponse`: Unlink a Salesforce record from a channel

- `admin.emoji.rename` -> `client.admin_emoji_rename(&AdminEmojiRenameRequest::new(name, new_name))` -> `AdminEmojiRenameResponse`: Rename an emoji.

## admin.functions

- `admin.functions.list` -> `client.admin_functions_list(&AdminFunctionsListRequest::new(app_ids))` -> `AdminFunctionsListResponse`: Look up functions by a set of apps.
- `admin.functions.permissions.lookup` -> `client.admin_functions_permissions_lookup(&AdminFunctionsPermissionsLookupRequest::new(function_ids))` -> `AdminFunctionsPermissionsLookupResponse`: Lookup the visibility of multiple Slack functions and include the users if it is limited to particular named entities.
- `admin.functions.permissions.set` -> `client.admin_functions_permissions_set(&AdminFunctionsPermissionsSetRequest::new(function_id))` -> `AdminFunctionsPermissionsSetResponse`: Set the visibility of a Slack function and define the users or workspaces if it is set to named_entities.

## admin.roles

- `admin.roles.addAssignments` -> `client.admin_roles_add_assignments(&AdminRolesAddAssignmentsRequest::new(role_id, entity_ids, user_ids))` -> `AdminRolesAddAssignmentsResponse`: Adds members to the specified role with the specified scopes
- `admin.roles.listAssignments` -> `client.admin_roles_list_assignments(&AdminRolesListAssignmentsRequest::new())` -> `AdminRolesListAssignmentsResponse`: Lists assignments for all roles across entities. Options to scope results by any combination of roles or entities
- `admin.roles.removeAssignments` -> `client.admin_roles_remove_assignments(&AdminRolesRemoveAssignmentsRequest::new(role_id, entity_ids, user_ids))` -> `AdminRolesRemoveAssignmentsResponse`: Removes a set of users from a role for the given scopes and entities

## admin.teams

- `admin.teams.create` -> `client.admin_teams_create(&AdminTeamsCreateRequest::new(team_domain, team_name))` -> `AdminTeamsCreateResponse`: Create an Enterprise team.
- `admin.teams.list` -> `client.admin_teams_list(&AdminTeamsListRequest::new())` -> `AdminTeamsListResponse`: List all teams in an Enterprise organization
- `admin.teams.owners.list` -> `client.admin_teams_owners_list(&AdminTeamsOwnersListRequest::new(team_id))` -> `AdminTeamsOwnersListResponse`: List all of the owners on a given workspace.
- `admin.teams.settings.info` -> `client.admin_teams_settings_info(&AdminTeamsSettingsInfoRequest::new(team_id))` -> `AdminTeamsSettingsInfoResponse`: Fetch information about settings in a workspace
- `admin.teams.settings.setDefaultChannels` -> `client.admin_teams_settings_set_default_channels(&AdminTeamsSettingsSetDefaultChannelsRequest::new(team_id, channel_ids))` -> `AdminTeamsSettingsSetDefaultChannelsResponse`: Set the default channels of a workspace.
- `admin.teams.settings.setDescription` -> `client.admin_teams_settings_set_description(&AdminTeamsSettingsSetDescriptionRequest::new(team_id, description))` -> `AdminTeamsSettingsSetDescriptionResponse`: Set the description of a given workspace.
- `admin.teams.settings.setDiscoverability` -> `client.admin_teams_settings_set_discoverability(&AdminTeamsSettingsSetDiscoverabilityRequest::new(team_id, discoverability))` -> `AdminTeamsSettingsSetDiscoverabilityResponse`: An API method that allows admins to set the discoverability of a given workspace
- `admin.teams.settings.setIcon` -> `client.admin_teams_settings_set_icon(&AdminTeamsSettingsSetIconRequest::new(image_url, team_id))` -> `AdminTeamsSettingsSetIconResponse`: Sets the icon of a workspace.
- `admin.teams.settings.setName` -> `client.admin_teams_settings_set_name(&AdminTeamsSettingsSetNameRequest::new(team_id, name))` -> `AdminTeamsSettingsSetNameResponse`: Set the name of a given workspace.

## admin.usergroups

- `admin.usergroups.addChannels` -> `client.admin_usergroups_add_channels(&AdminUsergroupsAddChannelsRequest::new(usergroup_id, channel_ids))` -> `AdminUsergroupsAddChannelsResponse`: Add up to one hundred default channels to an IDP group.
- `admin.usergroups.addTeams` -> `client.admin_usergroups_add_teams(&AdminUsergroupsAddTeamsRequest::new(usergroup_id, team_ids))` -> `AdminUsergroupsAddTeamsResponse`: Associate one or more default workspaces with an organization-wide IDP group.
- `admin.usergroups.addUsers` -> `client.admin_usergroups_add_users(&AdminUsergroupsAddUsersRequest::new(id, users))` -> `AdminUsergroupsAddUsersResponse`: Add members to an existing organizational usergroup.
- `admin.usergroups.create` -> `client.admin_usergroups_create(&AdminUsergroupsCreateRequest::new(name))` -> `AdminUsergroupsCreateResponse`: Create a new organizational usergroup.
- `admin.usergroups.fetch` -> `client.admin_usergroups_fetch(&AdminUsergroupsFetchRequest::new(id))` -> `AdminUsergroupsFetchResponse`: Fetch an organizational usergroup.
- `admin.usergroups.listChannels` -> `client.admin_usergroups_list_channels(&AdminUsergroupsListChannelsRequest::new(usergroup_id))` -> `AdminUsergroupsListChannelsResponse`: List the channels linked to an org-level IDP group (user group).
- `admin.usergroups.removeChannels` -> `client.admin_usergroups_remove_channels(&AdminUsergroupsRemoveChannelsRequest::new(usergroup_id, channel_ids))` -> `AdminUsergroupsRemoveChannelsResponse`: Remove one or more default channels from an org-level IDP group (user group).
- `admin.usergroups.removeTeams` -> `client.admin_usergroups_remove_teams(&AdminUsergroupsRemoveTeamsRequest::new(usergroup_id, team_ids))` -> `AdminUsergroupsRemoveTeamsResponse`: Remove one or more default workspaces from an organization-wide IDP Group or Admin Group
- `admin.usergroups.removeUsers` -> `client.admin_usergroups_remove_users(&AdminUsergroupsRemoveUsersRequest::new(id, users))` -> `AdminUsergroupsRemoveUsersResponse`: Remove members from an existing organizational usergroup.
- `admin.usergroups.update` -> `client.admin_usergroups_update(&AdminUsergroupsUpdateRequest::new(id))` -> `AdminUsergroupsUpdateResponse`: Update one or more properties of an existing organizational usergroup.
- `admin.usergroups.uploadUsers` -> `client.admin_usergroups_upload_users(&AdminUsergroupsUploadUsersRequest::new(id))` -> `AdminUsergroupsUploadUsersResponse`: Add members to an existing organizational usergroup in bulk via CSV upload.

## admin.users

- `admin.users.assign` -> `client.admin_users_assign(&AdminUsersAssignRequest::new(team_id, user_id))` -> `AdminUsersAssignResponse`: Add an Enterprise user to a workspace.
- `admin.users.getExpiration` -> `client.admin_users_get_expiration(&AdminUsersGetExpirationRequest::new(user_id))` -> `AdminUsersGetExpirationResponse`: Fetches the expiration timestamp for a guest.
- `admin.users.invite` -> `client.admin_users_invite(&AdminUsersInviteRequest::new(team_id, email, channel_ids))` -> `AdminUsersInviteResponse`: Invite a user to a workspace.
- `admin.users.list` -> `client.admin_users_list(&AdminUsersListRequest::new())` -> `AdminUsersListResponse`: List users on a workspace
- `admin.users.remove` -> `client.admin_users_remove(&AdminUsersRemoveRequest::new(team_id, user_id))` -> `AdminUsersRemoveResponse`: Remove a user from a workspace.
- `admin.users.session.clearSettings` -> `client.admin_users_session_clear_settings(&AdminUsersSessionClearSettingsRequest::new(user_ids))` -> `AdminUsersSessionClearSettingsResponse`: Clear user-specific session settings—the session duration and what happens when the client closes—for a list of users.
- `admin.users.session.getSettings` -> `client.admin_users_session_get_settings(&AdminUsersSessionGetSettingsRequest::new(user_ids))` -> `AdminUsersSessionGetSettingsResponse`: Get user-specific session settings—the session duration and what happens when the client closes—given a list of users.
- `admin.users.session.invalidate` -> `client.admin_users_session_invalidate(&AdminUsersSessionInvalidateRequest::new(user_id, session_id))` -> `AdminUsersSessionInvalidateResponse`: Revoke a single session for a user. The user will be forced to login to Slack.
- `admin.users.session.list` -> `client.admin_users_session_list(&AdminUsersSessionListRequest::new())` -> `AdminUsersSessionListResponse`: List active user sessions for an organization
- `admin.users.session.reset` -> `client.admin_users_session_reset(&AdminUsersSessionResetRequest::new(user_id))` -> `AdminUsersSessionResetResponse`: Wipes all valid sessions on all devices for a given user
- `admin.users.session.resetBulk` -> `client.admin_users_session_reset_bulk(&AdminUsersSessionResetBulkRequest::new(user_ids))` -> `AdminUsersSessionResetBulkResponse`: Enqueues an asynchronous job to wipe all valid sessions on all devices for a given list of users
- `admin.users.session.setSettings` -> `client.admin_users_session_set_settings(&AdminUsersSessionSetSettingsRequest::new(user_ids))` -> `AdminUsersSessionSetSettingsResponse`: Configure the user-level session settings—the session duration and what happens when the client closes—for one or more users.
- `admin.users.setAdmin` -> `client.admin_users_set_admin(&AdminUsersSetAdminRequest::new(team_id, user_id))` -> `AdminUsersSetAdminResponse`: Set an existing regular user or owner to be a workspace or org admin.
- `admin.users.setExpiration` -> `client.admin_users_set_expiration(&AdminUsersSetExpirationRequest::new(user_id, expiration_ts))` -> `AdminUsersSetExpirationResponse`: Set an expiration for a guest user
- `admin.users.setOwner` -> `client.admin_users_set_owner(&AdminUsersSetOwnerRequest::new(team_id, user_id))` -> `AdminUsersSetOwnerResponse`: Set an existing regular user or admin to be a workspace or org owner.
- `admin.users.setRegular` -> `client.admin_users_set_regular(&AdminUsersSetRegularRequest::new(team_id, user_id))` -> `AdminUsersSetRegularResponse`: Set an existing guest user, admin user, or owner to be a regular user.
- `admin.users.unsupportedVersions.export` -> `client.admin_users_unsupported_versions_export(&AdminUsersUnsupportedVersionsExportRequest::new())` -> `AdminUsersUnsupportedVersionsExportResponse`: Ask Slack to send you an export listing all workspace members using unsupported software, presented as a zipped CSV file.

## admin.workflows

- `admin.workflows.collaborators.add` -> `client.admin_workflows_collaborators_add(&AdminWorkflowsCollaboratorsAddRequest::new(workflow_ids, collaborator_ids))` -> `AdminWorkflowsCollaboratorsAddResponse`: Add collaborators to workflows within the team or enterprise
- `admin.workflows.collaborators.remove` -> `client.admin_workflows_collaborators_remove(&AdminWorkflowsCollaboratorsRemoveRequest::new(workflow_ids, collaborator_ids))` -> `AdminWorkflowsCollaboratorsRemoveResponse`: Remove collaborators from workflows within the team or enterprise
- `admin.workflows.permissions.lookup` -> `client.admin_workflows_permissions_lookup(&AdminWorkflowsPermissionsLookupRequest::new(workflow_ids))` -> `AdminWorkflowsPermissionsLookupResponse`: Look up the permissions for a set of workflows

- `admin.workflows.triggers.types.permissions.lookup` -> `client.admin_workflows_triggers_types_permissions_lookup(&AdminWorkflowsTriggersTypesPermissionsLookupRequest::new(trigger_type_ids))` -> `AdminWorkflowsTriggersTypesPermissionsLookupResponse`: List the permissions for using each trigger type
- `admin.workflows.triggers.types.permissions.set` -> `client.admin_workflows_triggers_types_permissions_set(&AdminWorkflowsTriggersTypesPermissionsSetRequest::new(id))` -> `AdminWorkflowsTriggersTypesPermissionsSetResponse`: Set the permissions for using a trigger type
- `admin.workflows.unpublish` -> `client.admin_workflows_unpublish(&AdminWorkflowsUnpublishRequest::new(workflow_ids))` -> `AdminWorkflowsUnpublishResponse`: Unpublish workflows within the team or enterprise

## agents

- `agents.sessions.rename` -> `client.agents_sessions_rename(&AgentsSessionsRenameRequest::new(title))` -> `AgentsSessionsRenameResponse`: Rename an agent session.
